svg.title: Four skills of divergent thinking: fluency, flexibility, originality, elaboration
svg.desc: A frieze of four triangles, alternately pointing up and down. Fluency: a dense burst of many identical small gold triangles. Flexibility: small triangles pointing out in six directions, each spoke a different colour. Originality: a field of identical violet triangles with one coral triangle turned the other way and set apart. Elaboration: a triangle subdivided again and again into finer triangles. Original course diagram after Chen (2011, 26).
